name: memory-gateway
description: Markdown vault memory gateway: R2 truth, D1 full-text + Vectorize semantic index, MCP + HTTP for any agent.
author: Varun

AGENT_TOKENS.description: JSON of agent name to token, e.g. {"claude":"<token>","hermes":"<token>"}. Make each token with `openssl rand -hex 24`; tokens under 16 characters are refused.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Token for /admin/* (reindex, status, restore). Make it with `openssl rand -hex 24`.

VAULT_PREFIX.description: Folder inside the bucket that holds your vault, ending in "/". Leave empty if notes sit at the bucket root.

EDIT_POLICY.description: Which agents may add and revise notes outside inbox/agents/, as JSON, e.g. {"claude":["journal/","projects/"]}. "{}" means nobody.
